queries.indexes: SELECT schemaname, tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='reference' AND tablename='prior_claims_corpus' ORDER BY indexname
queries.grants: SELECT grantee, table_schema, table_name, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema='reference' AND privilege_type='SELECT' ORDER BY grantee, table_name

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX prior_claims_corpus_lb_ann ON ONLY reference.prior_claims_corpus USING lakebase_ann (((embedding)::vector(1024)) vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE INDEX prior_claims_corpus_lb_bm25 ON ONLY reference.prior_claims_corpus USING lakebase_bm25 (to_tsvector('english'::regconfig, defect_narrative))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX prior_claims_corpus_pkey ON ONLY reference.prior_claims_corpus USING btree (claim_id)
